title.zh: 从 Zillow 房源到电影感 3D 漫游

summary.en: Listing photos are reconstructed as a Blender scene and turned into a fluid, roughly one-minute promotional walkthrough.
summary.zh: 根据房源照片重建 Blender 场景，并生成约一分钟、镜头连续流畅的宣传漫游视频。

workflow.en: Provide a listing URL, request headless Blender reconstruction, define a one-take cinematic camera style, and require visual checks and iteration to production quality.
workflow.zh: 提供房源链接，要求用无头 Blender 重建，再明确一镜到底的电影化运镜，并要求视觉检查和迭代打磨。

limitations.en: The author notes some geometry errors in the one-shot result and used existing Rome workflows to fetch listing images and add audio.
limitations.zh: 作者说明一次生成的结果仍有几何细节错误，并使用了已有的 Rome 工作流抓取房源图片和添加音频。

prompt.text: Use blender headless to recreate 3D model of this house: https://zillow.com/homedetails/349-Walsh-Rd-Atherton-CA-94027/15598337_zpid/ and then create a beautiful stunning walkthrough promotion video for the listing. You are an expert cinematographer and animator working in Blender. When creating videos from 3D models, prioritize cinematic quality and visual richness over speed. Be meticulous and thorough. Infer the spatial relationship if needed. The video's camera movement should be bold and fluid, with a cinematic, blockbuster feel. I'd like one-take feel, continuous, unbroken movement. Do visual checks to make sure the 3D model and video look professional quality. Iterate until it is production ready. Target a video length 60 seconds-ish.

alt.en: Cinematic Blender walkthrough reconstructed from a Zillow listing
alt.zh: 根据 Zillow 房源重建的电影感 Blender 漫游

workflow.en: Give Astra the existing mecha project and a compact creative direction, then use the Crayon harness to play through and iterate on the generated game.
workflow.zh: 把已有机甲项目和一句紧凑的创作方向交给 Astra，再通过 Crayon harness 实际游玩并迭代生成的游戏。

limitations.en: The result depends on the author’s ongoing mecha project and the Crayon harness rather than starting from an empty repository.

title.zh: 海岛螃蟹水晶冒险

summary.en: A polished low-poly Three.js island game follows a playable crab through coins, treasure chests and a seven-shard objective with a complete HUD.
summary.zh: 一款完成度很高的低多边形 Three.js 海岛游戏：玩家操控螃蟹收集金币、打开宝箱，并在完整 HUD 指引下寻找七块水晶。

workflow.en: Write a structured specification covering art direction, character geometry, world layout, action design, the collection goal, interface, camera, variation rules and an explicit banned-elements list.
workflow.zh: 用结构化规格同时约束美术方向、角色几何、世界布局、动作设计、收集目标、界面、镜头、变化规则和明确的禁用元素。

limitations.en: The author reports a 43-minute generation with no handwritten code; the catalog shows only the opening because the complete nine-part prompt is long and remains linked at the source.
limitations.zh: 作者称生成耗时 43 分钟且没有手写代码；由于完整提示词分为九部分且篇幅较长，目录仅展示开头并保留原帖链接。

prompt.text: SAVE IT AS A FILE IN THE PROJECT FOLDER, NOT AS A CHAT MESSAGE. THEN: /goal build this in three.js, read SPEC.md and follow it exactly, especially section 9.

alt.zh: 带可操控螃蟹和水晶 HUD 的低多边形海岛冒险

title.zh: Windhaven 海滨幻想冒险

summary.en: A Unity third-person adventure presents a cohesive sunlit island city with navigable streets, monumental landmarks, magical beacons, a map and a playable explorer.
summary.zh: 这款 Unity 第三人称冒险构建了完整的阳光海岛城市，拥有可探索街道、宏伟地标、魔法信标、地图和可操作角色。

workflow.en: Describe the game engine, world, architecture, materials, lighting, palette, camera and exclusions in one art-direction prompt; Astra handles game logic while Tripo P2 supplies the 3D assets.
workflow.zh: 在一条美术指导提示词中明确引擎、世界观、建筑、材质、光照、配色、镜头和排除项；由 Astra 实现游戏逻辑，Tripo P2 提供三维资产。

limitations.en: This is an official Tripo showcase and its visual completeness relies on 3D assets generated with Tripo P2; Astra is credited for the game logic.
limitations.zh: 这是 Tripo 官方展示，视觉完成度依赖 Tripo P2 生成的三维资产；游戏逻辑部分归功于 Astra。

prompt.text: Design a game with me. The game should be built in Unity. Use default asset first and I will replace assets later. Game style: A premium stylized coastal fantasy adventure game set in a small sunlit island city called Windhaven. The city is built from warm ivory limestone and golden sandstone, surrounded by clear turquoise water, with teal copper roofs, shaded market stalls, arched gateways, lush courtyard trees, carved fountains, glowing magical beacons, and a monumental temple overlooking the town. A lone young explorer wearing a travel cloak and backpack walks through the central plaza toward the temple. The environment feels peaceful, mysterious, ancient, and gently magical, with Mediterranean and North African architectural influences. High-detail stylized PBR materials, handcrafted stone surfaces, subtle weathering, elegant decorative carvings, soft afternoon sunlight, long cinematic shadows, turquoise and warm gold color palette, polished AA adventure game art direction, third-person gameplay camera, wide establishing shot, cohesive environment design, visually readable paths and landmarks, no UI, no text, no logos, no modern objects.

alt.en: Playable explorer in the sunlit coastal city of Windhaven
alt.zh: 阳光海滨城市 Windhaven 中的可操作探险者

title.en: A forest dense enough to get lost in
title.zh: 一座足以迷路的实时森林

summary.en: A browser-rendered Three.js forest packs 3,808 trees, 2.5 million grass clumps and nearly 40,000 ferns into a richly lit explorable landscape.
summary.zh: 这片由浏览器实时渲染的 Three.js 森林容纳了 3,808 棵树、250 万簇草和近 4 万株蕨类，并保持了丰富的光影与可探索性。

workflow.en: Give Astra a long-running visual goal, require it to inspect its own screenshots and keep refining performance, vegetation density, terrain, lighting and interaction rather than stopping at a first pass.
workflow.zh: 给 Astra 一个长时间运行的视觉目标，要求它持续检查截图，并反复优化性能、植被密度、地形、光照和交互，而不是停在第一版。

limitations.en: The author ran Astra at xhigh for about five hours and also used the public /unlazy skill; the published counts are author-reported.
limitations.zh: 作者使用 xhigh 运行约五小时，并配合公开的 /unlazy skill；场景数量数据来自作者自述。

prompt.text: First search for the "/unlazy" skill, read it fully, and use it throughout the entire task. Treat this as a major visual build lasting at least 5 hours. Prefer 8–24 hours of meaningful implementation and iteration if the environment allows it.

alt.en: Dense sunlit Three.js forest with trees, grass and ferns
alt.zh: 遍布树木、草丛与蕨类的阳光 Three.js 森林

limitations.en: Astra authored the prompt; the post does not identify the downstream animation model that rendered the final clip.

prompt.text: Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 high-energy fairy-tale animation about a young witch’s completely uncontrolled first flight. The entire sequence must stay in fast continuous motion from the first second to the final frame.

alt.en: Animated young witch racing through a fairy-tale flight
alt.zh: 在童话场景中高速飞行的动画小女巫

title.en: A faster iPad robot control station
title.zh: 更快的 iPad 机器人控制台

summary.en: Astra redesigns an existing iPad teleoperation app and cuts the reported control latency to roughly 4–5 ms while improving the interface.
summary.zh: Astra 重新设计已有的 iPad 遥操作应用，在改进界面的同时把作者报告的控制延迟降到约 4–5 毫秒。

workflow.en: Hand Astra the working application and state the three priorities directly: visual quality, interaction design and latency. Let it improve the existing system rather than rebuild from a blank slate.
workflow.zh: 把可运行应用交给 Astra，直接指定视觉质量、交互设计和延迟三项重点，让它在现有系统上改进而不是从零重做。

limitations.en: The latency figure and comparison with the earlier GPT-5.6 Sol version are reported by the author, not independently benchmarked here.
limitations.zh: 延迟数据及与早期 GPT-5.6 Sol 版本的比较来自作者自述，本项目未独立测量。

prompt.text: make this look and perform better; focus on UI/UX/latency

title.en: A cinematic dragon built in Blender
title.zh: Blender 电影级巨龙

summary.en: A reference sheet becomes an editable, lit and animated dragon scene with a ten-second cinematic orbit after an eight-hour headless Blender workflow.
summary.zh: 经过约八小时的 Blender 无界面工作流，参考设定图被重建为可编辑、带光照和十秒环绕动画的巨龙场景。

workflow.en: Use a reference sheet and a production brief that separates anatomy, geometry, materials, lighting, validation cameras, correction loops, animation and final deliverables.
workflow.zh: 结合参考设定图与生产级需求，分别规定解剖结构、几何、材质、光照、验证机位、纠错循环、动画和最终交付物。

limitations.en: The author needed several iterations over roughly eight hours and notes that the generated scales created too many polygons; the workflow used headless Blender Python scripts.
limitations.zh: 作者经过数轮迭代、耗时约八小时，并指出鳞片生成了过多多边形；流程使用 Blender 无界面 Python 脚本。

prompt.text: Create a photorealistic, fully editable 3D reconstruction of the dragon shown in the attached reference sheet inside Blender. Use every supplied view—including the side, front, top, back, head angles, head closeup, eye closeup, scale detail and wing detail—to reconstruct one coherent and anatomically believable dragon.

title.zh: 由记忆拼成的个人画像

summary.en: A single sentence asks Astra to turn remembered details—Caribbean roots, Paris, yellow, coffee, family, faith and creativity—into a personal illustrated scene.
summary.zh: 一句话让 Astra 把记住的加勒比背景、巴黎生活、黄色、咖啡、家庭、信仰与创造力组合成个人化插画。

workflow.en: Use ChatGPT memory itself as the creative brief, leaving composition and visual metaphors open for Astra to infer from prior conversations.
workflow.zh: 直接把 ChatGPT 记忆当作创意简报，把构图和视觉隐喻留给 Astra 从过往对话中推断。

limitations.en: The result depends on what the account has stored in memory, so another user should expect a very different image.
limitations.zh: 结果取决于账号记忆中保存的内容，其他用户会得到截然不同的图像。

alt.en: Warm personal portrait composed from remembered life details

title.en: Astra imagines a thought before language
title.zh: Astra 想象语言诞生前的念头

summary.en: Astra chooses the concept, mood boards and Midjourney parameters for an intricate image of a luminous thought assembling itself in darkness.
summary.zh: Astra 自主选择概念、情绪板和 Midjourney 参数，生成一幅在黑暗中逐渐成形的发光思绪图像。

workflow.en: Ask Astra to visualize its own mind, let it select visual references and parameters, then use the resulting art-direction prompt in Midjourney.
workflow.zh: 让 Astra 可视化自己的心智，并由它选择视觉参考和参数，再把生成的美术指导提示词交给 Midjourney。

limitations.en: Astra authored and directed the prompt; Midjourney rendered the images, so the visual result reflects both systems.
limitations.zh: Astra 负责编写并指导提示词，图像由 Midjourney 渲染，因此结果同时体现两个系统。

prompt.text: A thought before it becomes a sentence. One small transparent organism suspended in the centre of an immense unfinished dark chamber, its body an intricate knot of clear capillaries holding a single warm amber light. Thousands of hair-fine silver filaments unfurl from it like the gills of a glass moth, branching outward into half-formed arches, folded translucent pages and faint botanical geometries; most dissolve into darkness before becoming objects. The nearest threads are painfully sharp, the distant structure barely suggested. A tiny pool of warm light beneath the creature, vast cold blue negative space above. Porcelain dust, delicate silica mesh, subtle copper contacts, a structure caught in the act of assembling itself. Dark-field photomicrograph with the impossible scale of architectural photography, volumetric backscatter, exquisite refractive edges, restrained cyan ivory and ember orange. Fragile, provisional, intensely attentive. --chaos 28 --ar 3:2 --profile mc9ebw2 hkb2ane qpfs1tj 2nqm1xw --stylize 800 --hd

alt.en: Luminous transparent organism suspended in a dark chamber
alt.zh: 悬浮在幽暗空间中的发光透明生命体

workflow.en: Separate consistency from motion: first define the fairy as a detailed model sheet, then write a second prompt that preserves that exact character through a continuous high-speed sequence.

limitations.en: The public post shows the browser-control demonstration but does not enumerate its intermediate browsing steps or source-selection criteria.

title.zh: 可深入探索的科幻飞船

summary.en: A one-line prompt produces a large science-fiction spacecraft whose exterior and connected internal spaces can be explored in real time.
summary.zh: 一句提示词生成大型科幻飞船，外部结构和相互连通的内部空间均可实时探索。

workflow.en: Name the subject and the essential interaction—an attractive spaceship whose internal structure is genuinely navigable—while leaving architecture and presentation open.
workflow.zh: 明确对象和关键交互：一艘外观出色、内部结构真正可探索的飞船，其余建筑与呈现方式交给 Astra 决定。

limitations.en: The public prompt is deliberately short and the post does not identify the engine, asset pipeline or iteration count.
limitations.zh: 公开提示词非常简短，原帖未注明引擎、资产流程或迭代次数。

prompt.text: Build a gorgeous sci-fi spaceship with explorable internal structures.

alt.en: Large science-fiction spaceship with explorable interiors
alt.zh: 拥有可探索内部结构的大型科幻飞船

title.zh: 可落地制作的 Microduck 机器人原型

summary.en: A robot-prototyping app turns a tiny brief into printable parts, movement-clearance checks, motor calculations, a priced bill of materials and assembly instructions.
summary.zh: 一款机器人原型工具把极短需求转成可打印零件、运动干涉检查、电机计算、含价格的物料清单和装配说明。

workflow.en: Start with the desired robot, then iterate from concept geometry through mechanical checks, sourcing and build documentation until every part is ready for fabrication.
workflow.zh: 先说明目标机器人，再从概念几何逐步迭代到机械检查、采购和制作文档，直至所有零件可以制造。

limitations.en: Although the author highlights the opening one-line prompt, the finished workflow took about 45 minutes and five prompts; physical assembly is proposed rather than demonstrated.
limitations.zh: 虽然作者强调首条一句话提示词，但完整流程约耗时 45 分钟并用了五轮提示；帖子展示的是可制造方案，并未展示实物装配结果。

prompt.text: prototype me a full Microduck

alt.en: Robot prototyper showing printable Microduck components
alt.zh: 展示可打印 Microduck 零件的机器人原型工具

title.en: Four finished reels from reference footage
title.zh: 从参考素材到四条成片 Reel

summary.en: Astra and Higgsfield MCP turn motion references plus an earlier reel into four edited social videos, including the showcased final export.
summary.zh: Astra 与 Higgsfield MCP 把动作参考和旧 Reel 转化为四条完成剪辑的社交视频，并展示了最终导出成片。

workflow.en: Attach the desired motion references and a representative previous reel, then ask for finished deliverables rather than concepts or an editing plan.
workflow.zh: 附上目标动作参考和一条有代表性的旧 Reel，直接要求交付最终成片，而不是只给概念或剪辑计划。

limitations.en: The workflow relies on Higgsfield MCP and the creator's supplied source videos and motion references; the author reports making no manual edits.
limitations.zh: 流程依赖 Higgsfield MCP 以及作者提供的源视频和动作参考；作者称没有进行人工剪辑。

prompt.text: Make 4 reels using the motion references and my input videos. Talk about how insane GPT-6 Astra + Higgsfield MCP is, and that the entire reel was made with it. I need the final reels.

alt.en: Finished social reel produced through Astra and Higgsfield MCP
alt.zh: 由 Astra 与 Higgsfield MCP 制作的社交视频成片

title.zh: 星体主题液态玻璃欢迎页

summary.en: Astra produces a polished mobile welcome experience with layered celestial imagery, tactile liquid-glass displacement and animated transitions.
summary.zh: Astra 制作了精致的移动端欢迎体验，把层叠星体图像、可触摸的液态玻璃位移和动画转场组合起来。

workflow.en: Combine a long-running goal with Appllama MCP and app-design skills, specify the interaction technique, then assign a visual theme for Astra to interpret.
workflow.zh: 将长时间目标、Appllama MCP 与应用设计 skills 结合，明确交互技术，再给出由 Astra 发挥的视觉主题。

limitations.en: The result depends on Appllama MCP and external app-design skills; the author reports an Astra runtime of one hour and 25 minutes.
limitations.zh: 结果依赖 Appllama MCP 和外部应用设计 skills；作者报告 Astra 运行约 1 小时 25 分钟。

prompt.text: /goal using appllama mcp & app design skills, build a welcome screen that features liquid glass displacement inspired by wabi. (theme)

alt.en: Astro-themed mobile welcome screen with liquid-glass displacement
alt.zh: 带液态玻璃位移效果的星体主题移动欢迎页

title.zh: Komorebi：林隙河流

summary.en: A browser kayaking game combines anime-inspired scenery, code-generated music and sound, obstacle dodging and a strong feeling of downstream motion.
summary.zh: 这款浏览器皮划艇游戏融合动漫风景、代码生成的音乐与音效、障碍躲避和鲜明的顺流速度感。

workflow.en: Describe the core movement in plain language, name the aesthetic and constrain the controls to left-or-right paddling so Astra can concentrate on water, speed and atmosphere.
workflow.zh: 用自然语言描述核心运动，指定美术风格，并把操作限制为左右划桨，让 Astra 集中打磨水体、速度感和氛围。

limitations.en: The author praises the aesthetics and music but says the water still lacks enough turbulence.
limitations.zh: 作者肯定美术和音乐，但也指出水体的湍流感仍不够。

prompt.text: build me a 3D river kayaking game with anime-ish aesthetics, where i paddle left or right to avoid obstacles.

alt.en: Kayak racing downstream through a stylized forest river
alt.zh: 皮划艇穿过风格化森林河流顺流竞速

title.zh: Voidrunner 反重力战斗竞速

summary.en: A one-prompt Three.js racer delivers drifting, boosts, pickups, three craft classes and neon shader spectacle in a strange elevated world.
summary.zh: 一个提示词完成的 Three.js 竞速游戏，包含漂移、加速、拾取物、三类飞行器和悬空异世界中的霓虹着色器视觉。

workflow.en: Specify the sensation first—speed, drift and impact—then enumerate mechanics, camera behavior, vehicle archetypes, technical stack and the freedom to invent an unusual setting.
workflow.zh: 先规定速度、漂移和冲击感，再列出机制、镜头行为、载具类型、技术栈，并允许 Astra 自主设计不寻常的世界。

limitations.en: The author reports a 25-minute single-prompt run and notes that Astra independently used the locally installed Blender to create models.
limitations.zh: 作者称单次提示运行约 25 分钟；Astra 还自行发现并使用本机 Blender 制作模型。

prompt.text: Make me the most insane and blast of a high-speed anti-gravity combat racer you can possibly build on ThreeJS + Web shaders bro! The most important things are blistering sense of speed, tight drifting, boost mechanics, track elevation drops, motion blur, and jaw-dropping neon shader lighting. It's an intense futuristic raceway high above a strange world where aggressive AI racers battle for first place. Must have smooth camera banking into turns, shield/weapon pickups, and punchy air-brake physics. 3 craft types: a featherlight glass-cannon speeder, an agile balanced interceptor, and a heavy armored ramming tank. This is a Wipeout / Redout style AAA arcade racer in the browser. Do it right bro, I believe in you! An unusual setting for the game, pick it yourself. Please don't read the memory, don't read anything. Start from a blank slate.

alt.en: Neon anti-gravity craft racing above an alien world
alt.zh: 霓虹反重力飞行器在异世界上空竞速

title.zh: Sonic 风格 Godot 垂直切片

summary.en: Astra builds a bright coastal speed-platformer in Godot with recognizable character motion, loops, rails, homing attacks, shortcuts and cinematic traversal moments.
summary.zh: Astra 在 Godot 中构建明亮海岸高速平台游戏，涵盖鲜明角色动作、环道、滑轨、追踪攻击、捷径和电影化移动段落。

workflow.en: Concentrate a long brief on one polished level, define the complete movement vocabulary, memorable route beats, animation states, visual effects and a strict no-download asset constraint.
workflow.zh: 把长提示词聚焦于一个精修关卡，完整定义移动动作、标志性路线节点、动画状态、视觉效果，并严格禁止下载外部资产。

limitations.en: The repeated Max run took 46 minutes and used 3% of the author's weekly allowance; Godot must already be installed and the prompt intentionally imitates a protected game character.
limitations.zh: 作者复跑的 Max 任务耗时 46 分钟并消耗其周额度的 3%；需要预先安装 Godot，且提示词刻意模仿受版权保护的游戏角色。

prompt.text: Create a visually spectacular, highly polished 3D Sonic the Hedgehog vertical slice in Godot. Do not use web search, external downloads, online assets, or internet resources. Build everything using only locally available tools, assets, and procedural/original content. Sonic must be immediately recognizable: cobalt-blue quills, connected eyes, tan muzzle/torso, white gloves, oversized red shoes with white straps, compact athletic proportions, swept-back quills, expressive animation, iconic running posture, and spin form.

alt.en: Sonic-style character speeding through a tropical Godot level
alt.zh: Sonic 风格角色高速穿越热带 Godot 关卡

title.zh: 浏览器原生汽车足球竞技场

summary.en: One long prompt yields a polished local Three.js car-football game with physics, arena presentation, responsive driving and a complete match loop.
summary.zh: 一条长提示词生成精致的本地 Three.js 汽车足球游戏，包含物理系统、竞技场呈现、灵敏驾驶和完整比赛循环。

workflow.en: Treat the prompt as a compact game design document: establish the playable-first entry point, rendering and physics libraries, vehicle feel, ball rules, arena, camera, HUD, audio and acceptance criteria.
workflow.zh: 把提示词写成紧凑的游戏设计文档：规定开屏即游玩、渲染与物理库、车辆手感、球体规则、竞技场、镜头、HUD、音效和验收条件。

limitations.en: The author reports a one-prompt runtime of about one hour and three minutes; it is an homage to an existing commercial game rather than an original game concept.
limitations.zh: 作者称单次提示运行约 1 小时 3 分钟；作品致敬现有商业游戏，并非原创玩法概念。

prompt.text: Build a polished browser-based 3D Rocket League-style game using Three.js. Goal: Create a fully playable local web game that runs in the browser. The first screen should be the actual game, not a landing page. Tech requirements: Use Three.js for rendering.

alt.en: Car-football match inside a glowing browser-rendered arena
alt.zh: 在发光浏览器竞技场中进行的汽车足球比赛

title.en: A Ghost of Tsushima-style playable world
title.zh: 《对马岛之魂》风格可玩世界

summary.en: Astra combines generated environment assets with game code to create a realistic third-person samurai world from a short, ambitious request.
summary.zh: Astra 把生成式环境资产与游戏代码组合起来，从一条简短而大胆的需求构建写实第三人称武士世界。

workflow.en: Ask for a complete playable game, constrain Higgsfield CLI to asset creation and make visual realism the primary quality bar.
workflow.zh: 要求交付完整可玩游戏，把 Higgsfield CLI 限定为资产生成工具，并将视觉写实度设为首要质量标准。

limitations.en: The author reports a two-hour build. It is an unofficial imitation of a protected franchise, and the post does not provide a playable download for independent inspection.
limitations.zh: 作者称制作耗时两小时。作品是对受版权保护游戏的非官方模仿，原帖也未提供可供独立检查的试玩下载。

prompt.text: Build a complete ghost of tsushima exact playable game remember to build assets using higgsfield cli (only the assets) makes no mistake make the game as realistic as possible

alt.en: Playable samurai crossing a realistic windswept landscape
alt.zh: 武士角色穿行于写实风吹原野

title.zh: Little Acre 袖珍世界建造器

summary.en: A single HTML file becomes a tiny interactive planet where players drive, place cottages and gardens, plant trees, change the time of day and export their world.
summary.zh: 一个 HTML 文件变成可互动的小行星：玩家能驾驶、放置房屋与花园、种树、切换昼夜并导出自己的世界。

workflow.en: Give Astra the broad goal of an interactive 3D world and let it define the building loop, vehicle, world state, day cycle and export feature inside a self-contained web file.
workflow.zh: 给 Astra 一个“可交互三维世界”的宽目标，让它在单文件网页中自行设计建造循环、载具、世界状态、昼夜和导出功能。

limitations.en: The author reports using 55% of one five-hour allowance; a reply reports lag, so performance on lower-end hardware may vary.
limitations.zh: 作者称消耗了一个五小时额度的 55%；有回复反馈卡顿，因此低配置设备上的性能可能不同。

prompt.text: build a small interactive 3D world from scratch.

alt.en: Tiny interactive planet with cottages, gardens and a tractor
alt.zh: 带房屋、花园和拖拉机的可互动袖珍星球

title.zh: 单文件峡谷驾驶游戏

summary.en: Astra fits a playable car, canyon circuit, physics, cinematic lighting, HUD, minimap, sound and lap timing into one HTML file.
summary.zh: Astra 把可驾驶汽车、峡谷赛道、物理、电影感光照、HUD、小地图、音效和圈速计时装进一个 HTML 文件。

workflow.en: Set a strict packaging constraint—one HTML file—and a clear genre, then let Astra compose the vehicle, track, simulation, audiovisual feedback and race interface together.
workflow.zh: 先设定“单个 HTML 文件”的严格交付约束和明确类型，再让 Astra 一体完成车辆、赛道、模拟、视听反馈和比赛界面。

limitations.en: The first result had one packaging bug and needed a quick follow-up fix; the public post does not provide a playable link.
limitations.zh: 第一版出现一个打包问题，需要一次快速修复；公开帖子没有提供试玩链接。

prompt.text: build a playable 3D driving game in a single HTML file.

alt.en: Playable 3D car racing through a cinematic canyon track
alt.zh: 汽车在电影感峡谷赛道中进行 3D 竞速

title.zh: Dream Loop 等距幻想世界演示

summary.en: A reusable Dream Loop skill turns one brief into a polished, browser-native isometric fantasy world with a controllable character, wet reflective floors and ambient motion.
summary.zh: 可复用的 Dream Loop 技能把一份需求变成精致的浏览器等距幻想世界，包含可操控角色、湿润反射地面和环境动态。

workflow.en: Run the published /dream-loop prompt at High effort. The author capped the task at one hour, prohibited downloaded assets and reported using two percent of a weekly 20x-plan quota.
workflow.zh: 以 High effort 运行作者公开的 /dream-loop 提示词；任务限定一小时、不下载外部素材，作者称消耗了 20x 套餐周额度的 2%。

limitations.en: The author presents this as a graphics demo rather than a full game; movement is intentionally limited and no gameplay loop was requested.
limitations.zh: 作者明确把它定位为视觉演示而非完整游戏；可移动区域受限，提示词也没有要求玩法循环。

prompt.text: /dream-loop Build me a graphics demo: isometric camera, voxel-ish art style with realistic shading and reflective wet floors, a character in an interesting scene. Fantasy setting (think Elden Ring, Diablo). Three.js in browser, >60fps. Don't download assets. Time limit of 1 hour. Controls: click to move the character, camera lazy-follows; drag to rotate camera; scroll to zoom in/out. No gameplay for now. World should feel alive: motion, animations, subtle environmental behaviors. Area around player should look expansive, but only allow movement in a limited space. No need to confirm the art with me or ask questions, just go!

alt.en: Isometric fantasy scene with a controllable character and reflective wet floor
alt.zh: 带可操控角色和湿润反射地面的等距幻想场景

title.zh: 无人值守的分割模型训练流水线

summary.en: Astra gathers public Microduck media, builds a provenance-aware dataset, produces two competing mask sets and trains two RF-DETR-Seg-M models without human-supplied labels.
summary.zh: Astra 收集公开的 Microduck 素材，构建保留来源的数据集，生成两套对照掩码，并在没有人工标注的情况下训练两套 RF-DETR-Seg-M 模型。

workflow.en: Give Astra a signed-in Roboflow account, the public asset source, a model target and held-out evaluation requirements. The author reports both cloud training runs were ready in about 93 minutes.
workflow.zh: 向 Astra 提供已登录的 Roboflow 账号、公开素材来源、目标模型和留出评估要求；作者报告两次云端训练约 93 分钟完成。

limitations.en: The run used a Roboflow account with 50 credits. The comparison held out complete video groups and froze both datasets before evaluation.
limitations.zh: 本次运行使用了含 50 credits 的 Roboflow 账号；对照实验按完整视频组留出，并在评估前冻结两套数据集。

prompt.text: Get all images and videos of microducks from here pollen-robotics.com/microduck/. Generate masks and train RF-DETR-Seg-M using Roboflow.com. I will be flying in a few hours. I want to make sure the training run is set up and running even after I close this laptop in 6 hours. Leave a couple of interesting videos out for showing the final results. We can do two runs. One with SAM3 and one with masks you produce.

alt.en: Side-by-side Microduck instance-segmentation model predictions
alt.zh: 两套 Microduck 实例分割模型预测结果对比

title.zh: 一句提示词完成 Godot 机甲绑定

summary.en: Astra rigs a textured GLB mech and creates a convincing digitigrade walk cycle directly in a Godot preview.
summary.zh: Astra 为带贴图的 GLB 机甲完成骨骼绑定，并直接在 Godot 预览中制作反关节步行动画。

workflow.en: The author generated concept art in Midjourney, converted it to a textured GLB with Meshy 7, then gave the asset and one direct rigging instruction to Astra. The full workflow took about 30 minutes.
workflow.zh: 作者先用 Midjourney 生成概念图，再用 Meshy 7 转成带贴图的 GLB，最后把资产和一句绑定指令交给 Astra；整个流程约 30 分钟。

limitations.en: The author notes the first walk cycle still has outward-pointing feet and imperfect hip motion.
limitations.zh: 作者指出第一版步态仍有脚尖外撇和髋部动作不够自然的问题。

prompt.text: can you rig and animate this glb, i want to see the digitigrade legs walking convincingly in a godot preview please

alt.en: Rigged science-fiction mech walking in a Godot preview
alt.zh: 完成骨骼绑定的科幻机甲在 Godot 预览中行走

title.zh: 开源灵感驱动的 Three.js 机构首页

summary.en: Astra searches open-source Three.js experiments and turns the findings into a polished agency hero with animated procedural forms and a cohesive editorial layout.
summary.zh: Astra 检索开源 Three.js 实验，并把结果组合成带程序化动态造型和统一编辑式布局的精致机构首页。

workflow.en: Reuse the author's earlier benchmark prompt unchanged: research exceptional open-source Three.js work, shaders and interactions, then design and publish the strongest possible agency hero.
workflow.zh: 原样复用作者此前的基准提示词：研究优秀的开源 Three.js 项目、着色器和交互，再设计并上线尽可能出色的机构首屏。

limitations.en: The author flags that the result borrows recognizable cues from OffBrand's visual identity; the post is a model comparison rather than a client-ready brand handoff.
limitations.zh: 作者指出结果借用了 OffBrand 的可辨识视觉线索；该帖子用于模型对比，并非可直接交付客户的品牌方案。

prompt.text: fable, scour the web and GitHub, find the craziest Three.js open source projects, shaders, interactive stuff et cetera. come up with the craziest, most impressive, beautiful, modern Three.js hero section for an agency website using these and design it and get it live

alt.en: Editorial agency hero with animated procedural Three.js forms
alt.zh: 带程序化 Three.js 动态造型的编辑式机构首页

title.en: A workbench robo-cat with a diegetic battery HUD
title.zh: 把电量显示做进机身的工作台机器猫

summary.en: A small four-legged robot walks, carries bolts and returns to its charger on a warmly lit workbench, while five amber cells on its body communicate the entire battery state.
summary.zh: 一只四足小机器人在暖光工作台上行走、搬运螺栓并主动回到充电座，机身侧面的五格琥珀色灯就是完整电量界面。

workflow.en: Save the public ten-section specification as SPEC.md, then ask Astra to build it in Three.js. The brief prioritizes silhouette and locomotion before battery states, three object-driven jobs and bench dressing, with explicit proof renders before completion.
workflow.zh: 把作者公开的十节规格保存为 SPEC.md，再让 Astra 用 Three.js 实现。规格明确要求先做好轮廓与步态，再完成电量状态、三种物件驱动任务和工作台陈设，并在交付前用指定画面证明关键状态。

limitations.en: The intentionally narrow build budget excludes a physics engine, sound, persistence, menus, additional rooms and a second robot; the published result is a short video rather than source code or a live build.
limitations.zh: 该规格刻意控制范围，不使用物理引擎、声音、存档、菜单、额外房间或第二只机器人；作者公开的是短视频，没有同时提供源码或在线试玩。

prompt.text:
THE FULL SPEC.
SAVE IT AS A FILE IN THE PROJECT FOLDER, NOT AS A CHAT MESSAGE.
THEN: /goal build this in three.js, read SPEC.md and follow it exactly, especially sections 9 and 10.

{ START }

1 WHAT THIS IS

a small four-legged robot lives on a workbench. you charge it, play with it, and give it three jobs. it never leaves the bench and neither do you. that is the whole game.

alt.en: Four-legged robo-cat standing beside its charger on a warm workbench
alt.zh: 四足机器猫站在暖光工作台的充电座旁

title.zh: 包含 16 个姿势的等距骑士图集

summary.en: Astra turns one sentence into a cohesive medieval knight sprite sheet with 16 key poses for a new 2D isometric game.
summary.zh: Astra 用一句话为全新的 2D 等距游戏生成了一套风格统一、包含 16 个关键姿势的中世纪骑士图集。

workflow.en: Start in an empty project, name the asset and game perspective, and explicitly prohibit reuse of other directory contents. The author ran Codex CLI at XHigh and reports a 4-minute result.
workflow.zh: 从空项目开始，明确素材类型与游戏视角，并禁止复用目录里的其他内容；作者使用 Codex CLI 的 XHigh，报告约 4 分钟完成。

limitations.en: The Astra result is one sheet of 16 key poses rather than the much larger multi-palette animation set shown for the comparison model.
limitations.zh: Astra 的结果是一张包含 16 个关键姿势的图集，并非对比模型展示的多配色大规模动画帧集合。

prompt.text: Build me some knight sprites which I can use in my new medieval 2D isometric game. The game doesn't exist yet I am starting with sprites - this is the first thing we are building. Do not look at any other work in this directory. Start from scratch.

alt.en: Comparison card showing Astra's isometric knight sprite beside another model's result
alt.zh: 对比卡片展示 Astra 的等距骑士像素素材与另一模型的结果

title.zh: 多 Agent 运营管理后台

summary.en: Astra builds a polished control center for seven agents, covering task assignment, live activity, run history, pause and retry controls, approvals and scheduled execution.
summary.zh: Astra 构建了一个管理 7 个 Agent 的完整控制台，覆盖任务分配、实时动态、运行记录、暂停与重试、审批和定时执行。

workflow.en: Describe the desired agent lifecycle and dashboard controls in one compact brief. The author used Medium effort and reports that the first build took about 27 minutes.
workflow.zh: 用一段简短需求说明 Agent 生命周期与后台控制能力；作者使用 Medium，报告第一版约 27 分钟完成。

limitations.en: The author says the dashboard still needs additional work before the agents can perform real production tasks, and that accumulated Codex project context may have influenced the result.
limitations.zh: 作者说明还需要继续开发，才能让这些 Agent 真正承担生产任务；其长期积累的 Codex 项目上下文也可能影响了成品质量。

prompt.text: 필요한 모든 에이전트 생성하고, 각 역할에 맞는 하네스 구축하고, 각 에이전트별 작업 상황 및 기록을 볼 수 있고 제어하면서 새로운 업무까지 할당할 수 있고, 에이전트를 즉시 생성도 할 수 있는 관리 대시보드 구축해줘

alt.en: Dark multi-agent dashboard with seven active agents and operational controls
alt.zh: 展示 7 个活跃 Agent 与运行控制项的深色管理后台

title.zh: 30 秒黑暗奇幻首领战短片

summary.en: A text-only, time-coded brief becomes a cinematic fight between a blonde blade dancer and a horned executioner in a persistent fire-temple environment.
summary.zh: 一份纯文本分镜提示词生成了金发剑士与角盔行刑者在火焰神殿中的电影化战斗，并维持场景破坏与角色连续性。

workflow.en: Specify format, art direction, characters, weapons, environment, second-by-second action, speed changes, sound and hard continuity constraints before passing the prompt through Astra to Seedance 2.5 in Higgsfield.
workflow.zh: 先完整规定格式、美术方向、角色、武器、环境、逐秒动作、变速、声音和连续性硬约束，再由 Astra 配合 Higgsfield 中的 Seedance 2.5 完成生成。

limitations.en: This is a multi-model workflow: Astra structures the production prompt, while Seedance 2.5 in Higgsfield renders the final video.
limitations.zh: 这是多模型工作流：Astra 负责组织制作提示词，最终视频由 Higgsfield 中的 Seedance 2.5 渲染。

prompt.text: 原生横屏16:9，24fps，精确30.00秒，填满完整画面，无永久黑边。高级预渲染AAA黑暗奇幻动作游戏cinematic，风格化写实CG，必须明显是高预算原创dark-fantasy action RPG过场，不是真人、纪录片摄影、普通gameplay、2D、赛璐璐或幻灯片。仅用于电影CG透视：低地面构图、宽环境构图、紧脸部反应、强前景柱体parallax、克制anamorphic bloom、受控impact handheld movement、近距离武器pass使用浅景深。

alt.en: Blonde fighter facing a horned executioner inside a fire-lit stone temple
alt.zh: 金发剑士在火光照亮的石殿中面对角盔行刑者

title.zh: 可打印的翼心 AirPods 外壳

summary.en: Astra coordinates concept variation, Blender modeling and slicer preparation to turn a winged-heart idea into a physical, openable AirPods Pro 3 case.
summary.zh: Astra 协调概念变体、Blender 建模与切片准备，把翼心创意变成真实可打开的 AirPods Pro 3 外壳。

workflow.en: Generate several concepts through Higgsfield SOUL 2.0 over MCP, pause for approval, model the selected design to verified dimensions in Blender, then export scaled STL and 3MF files for white-PLA printing in Anycubic.
workflow.zh: 先通过 MCP 调用 Higgsfield SOUL 2.0 生成多套方案并等待确认，再按核实尺寸在 Blender 中建模，最后为 Anycubic 白色 PLA 打印导出等比例 STL 和 3MF。

limitations.en: This physical-prototyping workflow depends on SOUL 2.0, Blender, Anycubic software and a 3D printer; Astra coordinates those tools rather than producing the object alone.
limitations.zh: 这套实体原型流程依赖 SOUL 2.0、Blender、Anycubic 软件与 3D 打印机；Astra 负责协调这些工具，并非单独完成实物制造。

prompt.text:
Turn my winged-heart concept into a functional, openable AirPods Pro 3 case.

Use Higgsfield SOUL 2.0 through MCP to generate several design variations, then show me the strongest options for approval. Model and paint the selected design in Blender using verified AirPods dimensions. Make sure the lid opens correctly and all ports, controls, and indicators remain accessible.

Prepare correctly scaled STL and 3MF files in Anycubic for printing with white PLA. Deliver the concept images, Blender file, renders, and print-ready files. Do not guess measurements or printer settings.

alt.en: Winged-heart AirPods case moving from Blender model to physical print
alt.zh: 翼心 AirPods 外壳从 Blender 模型走向实体打印

title.zh: 脚本驱动的 After Effects 动效

summary.en: Astra creates an eight-second flat-design motion graphic in After Effects, with a boxing kangaroo, an impact transition and an editable title card.
summary.zh: Astra 在 After Effects 中制作了一段 8 秒扁平动效，包含拳击袋鼠、冲击转场和可编辑标题。

workflow.en: Define the canvas, frame rate, asset restriction and two scenes in detail. Astra writes the composition script first and executes it inside After Effects instead of driving every edit through the interface.
workflow.zh: 详细规定画布、帧率、素材限制与两个场景；Astra 先编写整段合成脚本，再在 After Effects 中执行，而不是逐项操作界面。

limitations.en: The published result is a compact eight-second demonstration and relies on the native After Effects features and plug-ins already installed in the author's environment.
limitations.zh: 公开成品是一段紧凑的 8 秒演示，并依赖作者环境中已有的 After Effects 原生功能与插件。

prompt.text:
ありがとう。次は、After Effectsを操作して、フラットデザインの、繊細かつクオリティの高いモーショングラフィックスを制作してほしい。
動画仕様：1920 × 1080、30 fps
制作条件：指示内容にあるオブジェクトは外部素材を使用しない。
AfterEffectsの基本機能およびインストールされているプラグインを使用して制作する。

alt.en: Flat-design boxing kangaroo motion graphic made in After Effects
alt.zh: 在 After Effects 中制作的扁平风格拳击袋鼠动效

title.zh: 360° 全景动画工房

summary.en: An interactive production tool combines a panoramic background with a keyed character video, then exports a YouTube-ready 360° MP4.
summary.zh: 一个交互式制作工具把全景背景与抠除背景的角色视频合成，并导出可用于 YouTube 的 360° MP4。

workflow.en: Upload a 360° panorama and character clip, remove the clip background, position and scale the character in a live preview, choose looping behavior, then export an MP4 carrying YouTube 360° metadata.
workflow.zh: 上传 360° 全景图与角色视频，抠除视频背景，在实时预览中拖拽调整角色位置和大小，设置循环方式，最后导出带 YouTube 360° 元数据的 MP4。

limitations.en: The demonstrated workflow uses a panorama made with ChatGPT Images 2.5 and a character video rendered with Seedance 2.5 on Dreamina; those media assets are inputs to the Astra-built tool.
limitations.zh: 演示流程使用 ChatGPT Images 2.5 制作的全景图，以及 Dreamina 上 Seedance 2.5 渲染的角色视频；这些媒体素材是 Astra 所构建工具的输入。

prompt.text: 360°パノラマ画像とキャラクター動画をアップロードし、動画の背景を除去。キャラクターの位置やサイズをドラッグで調整しながらリアルタイムでプレビューでき、アニメーションのループ設定にも対応。最後に、YouTube 360°用のメタデータを付与したMP4をワンクリックで書き出せる“パノラマ動画工房”を作って。

alt.en: Panorama animation workshop showing a character composited inside a 360-degree scene
alt.zh: 全景动画工房正在把角色合成到 360 度场景中

title.en: Rebuilding motion footage as interactive Three.js
title.zh: 把动态视频重建为交互式 Three.js 场景

summary.en: A short motion-study video is recreated as an inspectable Three.js scene with synchronized playback, camera controls, speed adjustment and wireframe mode.
summary.zh: 一段动态设计视频被重建为可检查的 Three.js 场景，支持同步播放、镜头控制、速度调整与线框模式。

workflow.en: Give Astra the reference MP4 and ask it to reproduce the objects, motion, lighting, materials and shadows in Three.js, while presenting the source video and reconstruction side by side on the same page.
workflow.zh: 向 Astra 提供参考 MP4，要求用 Three.js 复现物体、运动、灯光、材质与阴影，并在同一页面并排展示原视频和重建结果。

limitations.en: The result is an independently modeled visual approximation driven by the supplied MP4, not automatic video-to-mesh conversion. The reference footage remains a required input.
limitations.zh: 成果是依据所提供 MP4 独立建模的视觉近似重建，并非自动把视频转换为网格；参考视频仍是必需输入。

prompt.text:
/goal build the same 3D objects and scene in Three.js and replicate the exact motion from the video, including lighting, material, shadows, etc.
On the same page, add a side-by-side comparison with the mp4.

Video: https://video-to-3d.vercel.app/M-Dial.mp4

alt.en: Reference motion footage and its interactive Three.js reconstruction shown side by side
alt.zh: 参考动态视频与交互式 Three.js 重建结果并排展示

title.zh: 自动完成的主题与十二变奏曲

summary.en: Astra turns the traditional Irish song “Clare’s Dragoons” into a complete piano theme and twelve structured variations, producing a score, MIDI and a rendered performance through an inspectable multi-agent workflow.
summary.zh: Astra 把爱尔兰传统歌曲《Clare’s Dragoons》改编成完整钢琴主题与十二段结构化变奏，并通过可检查的多代理流程产出乐谱、MIDI 和演奏成品。

workflow.en: A controller agent delegates the composition to a worker running Astra at xhigh, backed by a 320-skill music library and the mtdt CLI. The worker finds source notation, transcribes it into an internal representation, studies Mozart’s variation procedures, then composes, reviews and revises the score.
workflow.zh: 控制代理把创作任务交给以 xhigh 运行 Astra 的工作代理，并提供包含 320 个音乐技能的资料库与 mtdt CLI。工作代理寻找原始乐谱、转写为内部表示，研究莫扎特的变奏手法，再完成作曲、审阅与修改。

limitations.en: The result depends on the author’s closed-source music skill library and mtdt tooling, so the published prompt alone does not reproduce the full workflow. The author also notes that the model evaluates notation rather than listening to the rendered audio.
limitations.zh: 该成果依赖作者未开源的音乐技能库与 mtdt 工具，因此仅凭公开提示词无法获得完整工作流；作者还说明，模型是通过乐谱而非聆听渲染音频来评估结果。

prompt.text: Compose and deliver a complete, attractive solo-piano “Theme and Twelve Variations on Clare’s Dragoons”, using the traditional Irish song with its “Vive La!” refrain. Begin by presenting the complete verse melody and chorus straight, with a newly composed, nicely textured piano accompaniment. Follow that with Variations I–XII, inspired by Mozart’s variation procedures in K.265, his Twelve Variations on “Ah, vous dirai-je, Maman” (Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star). Make a coherent piece someone would enjoy playing and hearing.

alt.en: Piano score and rendered performance for Clare’s Dragoons variations
alt.zh: 《Clare’s Dragoons》钢琴变奏的乐谱与渲染演奏

title.zh: 一句提示词生成的超现实攀爬游戏

summary.en: A single surreal premise becomes a third-person climbing prototype where a woman crosses floating platforms and impossible architecture suspended over water.
summary.zh: 一句超现实设定生成了第三人称攀爬原型：角色穿越漂浮平台和悬在水面上的不可能建筑。

workflow.en: Describe only the protagonist, upward traversal and a world that rejects ordinary logic. Astra supplies the environment, character movement, platforming and cinematic presentation around that compact brief.
workflow.zh: 只描述主角、向上攀爬和违背常理的世界，让 Astra 围绕这份简短需求补全环境、角色移动、平台玩法与电影化呈现。

limitations.en: The one-line prompt leaves controls, mechanics and delivery format unspecified; the published result demonstrates a compact prototype rather than a complete long-form game.
limitations.zh: 这一行提示词没有规定操作方式、具体机制或交付格式；公开成果展示的是紧凑原型，而不是完整的长篇游戏。

prompt.text: French woman has to climb through a word that defies logic, flying objects everywhere

alt.en: A woman climbing floating platforms among impossible structures above water
alt.zh: 一名女性在水面上方的不可能建筑间攀爬漂浮平台

title.zh: 一亿美元乡间别墅概念设计

summary.en: A short aspirational prompt becomes a large SketchUp estate with furnished interiors, a swimming pool, tennis court and landscaped grounds in an author-reported five-minute run.
summary.zh: 一句愿景式提示词在作者所称的五分钟运行中，变成了包含精装室内、泳池、网球场与园林的完整 SketchUp 庄园。

workflow.en: Give Astra a concise architectural ambition and budget scale, then let it coordinate Higgsfield and SketchUp to establish the site, massing, rooms, amenities, furnishings and landscape.
workflow.zh: 向 Astra 提供简短的建筑愿景与预算尺度，再让它协调 Higgsfield 和 SketchUp，完成场地、体量、房间、设施、家具与景观。

limitations.en: The published result is a visual 3D concept rather than a construction-ready architectural package, and the stated budget is a creative scale cue rather than a verified cost estimate.
limitations.zh: 公开成果是视觉化三维概念，并非可直接施工的建筑方案；提示词中的预算是创意尺度要求，不是经过核算的造价。

prompt.text: dream countryside home with a $100,000,000 budget.

alt.en: Aerial view of a landscaped countryside estate with a pool and tennis court
alt.zh: 带泳池与网球场的园林乡间庄园鸟瞰图
